name: SymbolicLM rewrite pipeline: local routing gate and acceptance check around SymbolicProofingLLM (no retraining)
owner_request: Iteration 2 repairs well (37.6% good repairs with judges) but changes 15-20% of working sentences; the boundary is parser behaviour, not surface form. Test whether SymbolicLM itself, with LOCAL deterministic checks, can decide which sentences go to the model and whether to accept its output.
frozen_before_results: Written before any gated arm was computed or scored. The raw model outputs per sentence unit (GGUF Q8_0 through llama-server, greedy) are shared by all arms; the arms are deterministic post-processing of those outputs.

hypotheses.H1: Break rate of working sentences (500 working symbolic_english test sentences and 495 sealed identity pairs: analysis or text changed) is at most 1% (point estimate, Wilson upper bound reported) for the best gated arm with the acceptance check.
hypotheses.H2: The best arm keeps repairs clearly above no rewrite on the 739 sealed repair pairs (analysis correct AND meaning kept; paired bootstrap 95% interval of the difference above 0), local only and with judges.
hypotheses.H3: K3 (clean paragraphs untouched) and K2 clean sentences changed fall to at most 1%; K5 pronouns kept at 99% or more.

arms: it2 with gate g1|g2|g3 x acceptance none|a|am (9 arms)
it1 with the best it2 gate and acceptance

definitions.certified: every sentence of the text has identical Stanza default and accurate trees (head and deprel, class `identical` of lib/symbolic-lm/uncertainty.mjs compareSentence over tokens: tools/datasets/neuro-oracle/classify.mjs treeAgreement)
definitions.g1: send a sentence unit only when it is not certified (trees differ)
definitions.g2: g1 OR SymbolicLM does not handle the unit alone (invalid, unparsed span, any uncertainty reason): the existing `symbolic` gate of tools/eval/composed/score-rewrite.mjs
definitions.g3: send every unit (the chat setting, reference)
definitions.acceptance a: every sentence of the model output is certified AND the mechanical meaning checks hold (names, numbers, negation, quantifiers, question kind, non-empty), per unit; otherwise the original unit is kept
definitions.acceptance am: a AND the local analysis comparison (analysis-compare-v1) of unit and output is not `different`

evaluation.sets: sealed proofing pairs (739 repair, 495 identity; every input cut by the host splitter), 500 working symbolic_english test sentences (sym500), composed K2, K3, K5 (sentence mode) and K6 (sentence mode)
evaluation.metrics: tools/eval/symbolic-proofing-eval.mjs score summaries and tools/eval/composed-score.mjs rewrite summaries, each arm reported (a) local only and (b) with the DeepSeek judges applied to the residue (items without a cached verdict) only
evaluation.stats: Wilson 95% on rates, paired bootstrap 95% (10,000 resamples, seed 7) on differences

decision_rule: If the best arm has a break rate of at most 1% and repairs clearly above no rewrite, implement it as an optional rewrite pipeline in lib/symbolic-lm (gate g1 or g2 plus acceptance), off by default, configurable, with tests and DS014 text; do NOT turn it on by default.
early_stopping: Evaluation only, no training; staged by arm. An arm is dropped from the judge residue when its local-only break rate or repair gain is already decisive against it.
non_goals: no training, no change to any default, no change to the rules lib/ud-to-sop, no tuning on sealed files
